model.title: Title IX Clarification Act of 2026
model.meta: Education and Workforce Committee · Rep. Jodey Arrington (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would clarify that federal nondiscrimination rules under Title IX, which apply to schools and educational programs receiving government funding, define sex discrimination based on biological sex rather than other frameworks. It aims to establish that Title IX's protections are grounded in biological categories of sex.
